title: Test feedback on the learner who missed
statement: Test feedback on learners who just answered wrong: it works if they can say what went wrong and where to reread, and its mere presence proves nothing.
detail: A Grade 5 reading course's student-readiness criteria test feedback with Grade 5 readers or a strict stand-in: after a wrong answer, the student must be able to identify what went wrong and where to reread within a short interval. The framework's evidence is that an earlier round found feedback too long, sometimes longer than the passage, with capitalisation defects and sometimes generic, while a count of feedback present could not show whether a child could use it. Its fix also audits feedback for brevity, correctness, failure-mode specificity and grade-level wording.
